blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Wednesday urged the public not to panic over the Philippine peso’s continued slide to a record low of 64 to the US dollar, saying the government is doing everything it can to prevent further depreciation. Marcos’ statement came after the peso breached another record low of 64.17
